intro.title: Add a device (4 steps, about 10 minutes)
intro.description: A new device opens a Wi-Fi network of its own for setup. Your phone joins it for a minute to enter the organization's ID, registration code and the bin's location; after that the device works over cellular on its own.

stepOne.title: Prepare
stepOne.description: The bin's location, and what the device needs for its first start.

checklist.empty: The bin is empty and its lid closed: its first start measures the empty bin's depth for 20 seconds, and everything else is measured against it.
checklist.power: A SIM card is in and the battery is charged.
checklist.sky: Optional: take the bin's location below, to skip waiting for GPS. Without it the device must be outdoors for a GPS fix before it can register.
checklist.phone: Your phone is at hand: it joins the device's network for a minute.
checklist.scale: A bin with a scale: have an object of known weight ready, to calibrate the scale after the first report.

stepTwo.title: Connect your phone to the device
stepTwo.description: The device's own network, only for setup.

steps.powerOn: Turn the device on. A device that has not joined an organization opens a Wi-Fi network named S-Bin-A02-… .
steps.joinNetwork: On your phone, open the Wi-Fi settings and join that network (it has no password). The phone warns that it has no internet: choose to stay connected (on an iPhone "Use without internet", on Android "Yes" or "Keep connection").
steps.openPage: Do not wait for a setup page and do not type anything: come back to this page (switch back to your browser) and go on.

stepTwo.noInternetNote: It is the device's network, not the internet, so this warning is expected. If the next step's button does not open the device, turn off your mobile data for a minute (some phones prefer it over a Wi-Fi network without internet) and try again. Stay connected until the details are saved.
stepTwo.noNetworkNote: The device has joined an organization before, so it does not open its setup network. An owner can reset it with "Delete via MAC" in the side menu; it then opens the network again.

stepThree.title: Send the details to the device
stepThree.description: From this page, while your phone is on the device's network.

steps.enter: Can't use the button? On the device's setup page (http://192.168.4.1) enter the organization ID and the registration code below, and press "Save and connect". That way no location is passed: the device takes a GPS fix.
steps.restart: The device restarts and its network closes; your phone goes back to its usual network.

stepThree.sendHint: Tap it while your phone is on the device's network: the device saves the organization, the code and the location, and restarts. Nothing to type.
stepThree.fieldsHint: Both are also in the organization's settings. Keep the code to the people who install devices.
stepThree.withoutLocation: No location taken: the device will wait for a GPS fix. To skip that, go back to step 1 and take it before joining the device's network (the phone needs internet for it).

stepFour.title: Wait for its first report
stepFour.description: From here the device works on its own, over cellular.

steps.gps: Uses the location it was sent; without one, takes its first GPS fix (outdoors, a few minutes).
steps.measure: Measures the empty bin for 20 seconds (keep it empty, closed and still).
steps.register: Registers in the organization and sends its first report.

stepFour.timeNote: Usually 5 to 10 minutes. Then it appears in the bins list, named Bin-… (it can be renamed on its page).

calibration.how: The device keeps the deepest distance it measures in 20 seconds as the empty bin; if no reading comes, it tries once more.
calibration.notEmpty: Something in the bin then counts as empty: every later fill level reads too low.
calibration.redo: Measured with something inside? Empty the bin and send "Recalibrate empty-bin reference" from the bin page's Remote commands; it runs at the device's next report.
calibration.scale: A bin with a scale: this measurement also sets the scale's zero. To weigh in grams, put an object of known weight in the bin and send "Calibrate scale with a known weight" from the same Remote commands.

stepFour.troubleshootTitle: Not in the list after 15 minutes?

troubleshoot.notListed: Check the SIM card and the cellular coverage where it stands.
troubleshoot.noFix: No location sent and no GPS fix indoors: move it outdoors (it keeps trying), or set it up again with the Send button.
troubleshoot.wrongDetails: A wrong ID or code: the device opens its setup network again; repeat steps 2 and 3.

a.content: Welcome to S-Bin, the smart waste-management solution. These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of the S-Bin website, platform, and any related services (collectively, the “Services”). By accessing or using our Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

b.title: 2. Services
b.content: S-Bin provides technology for monitoring and managing waste bins, including sensors, communication modules, a management platform, and (if applicable) a mobile application. The Services may include real-time fill-level monitoring, notifications, reports, and integration with third-party platforms.

c.title: 3. Eligibility
c.content: You must be at least 18 years old or have the legal authority of your organization to use the Services. By using the Services on behalf of an entity, you represent that you are authorized to bind that entity to these Terms.

list.1: Some parts of the Services may require you to create an account.
list.2: You agree to provide accurate and complete information and to keep your credentials secure.
list.3: You are responsible for all activity under your account.

list.1: Use the Services in any way that violates applicable laws or regulations.
list.2: Interfere with or disrupt the Services or the networks connected to them.
list.3: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the Services or to other users’ data.

f.title: 6. Data and Privacy
f.content: S-Bin collects and processes data about bin fill levels, location, and usage to provide the Services. We take privacy and data security seriously and implement reasonable measures to protect the information we collect. By using the Services, you consent to our collection and use of data as described in our Privacy Policy.

g.title: 7. Intellectual Property
g.content: All content, software, and technology in the Services (including the S-Bin name, logo, and related trademarks) are owned by or licensed to us and are protected by intellectual property laws. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Services for their intended purpose.

h.title: 8. Third-Party Services and Integrations
h.content: Our Services may integrate with third-party platforms or networks (e.g., municipal systems, IoT platforms). We are not responsible for the actions or policies of those third parties.

i.title: 9. Disclaimers
i.content: The Services are provided “as is” and “as available.” We do not warrant that the Services will be uninterrupted, error-free, or completely accurate. You use the Services at your own risk.

j.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
j.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, S-Bin and its affiliates will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Services.

k.title: 11. Changes to the Services and Terms
k.content: We may update or modify the Services at any time. We may also update these Terms from time to time. The latest version will be posted on our website. Continued use of the Services after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

l.title: 12. Termination
l.content: We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services if you violate these Terms or if required by law. Upon termination, your right to use the Services will cease immediately.
